findings.description: At 00:00 the bowl holds exactly 2 red balls (plus 3 yellow, 3 green). By 00:00.75-00:01.00 the child is holding a red ball above the bowl while both original red balls are still visible in the bowl in the same positions, and all 8 original balls are still present. A third red ball appeared with no visible source (nothing was taken from the table or elsewhere).

At 00:05.25 about 8-9 balls are visible in the bowl; at 00:05.75 only ~5 are visible (green, 2 yellow, green, one red under the fingertips) although the hand covers only a small region and no ball is seen leaving the bowl. Several balls vanish during the stir.
